astronomy_picture_of_the_day.title: The Nebulous Realm of WR 134
astronomy_picture_of_the_day.explanation: This cosmic snapshot covers a field of view over twice as wide as the full Moon within the boundaries of the high-flying constellation Cygnus. Made using astronomical narrowband filters, the image highlights the bright edge of a ring-like nebula traced by the glow of ionized hydrogen and oxygen gas.
